reasoning_traces.think:
The three core primitives form a triadic motivational system where competitive alignment drives internal coherence, perceived parity sustains belief in parity, and resolve translates into action. These interact in a feedback loop: alignment increases resolve, which reinforces perceived parity, and vice versa. The failure mode arises when resolve is insufficient to overcome resistance—this manifests as a breakdown in the motivational chain. The mathematical structure mirrors a Bayesian network with probabilistic dependencies among motivational states. Each primitive represents a distinct layer of decision-making: cognitive framing (alignment), belief validation (parity), and behavioral execution (resolve). Dualities emerge in the tension between self-interest and collective ambition, and between physical capability and mental fortitude. The system exhibits nonlinearity due to thresholds in motivational intensity and perceptual accuracy.
